artworks.title: Plate 29: Geese with Poppies and a Cyclamen
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting depicts three ducks in a natural setting. The scene includes three ducks with different plumage against a backdrop of flowers and foliage. Two ducks are on land and one is partially submerged in water. Surrounding plants include blooming red poppies and delicate green stems. The artwork is detailed, focusing on the textures of feathers and botanical elements. This style is reminiscent of a naturalist approach from the 16th or 17th century.

artworks.title: Plate 30: A Muscovy(?) Duck, a Four-Legged Duck, and Two Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts four birds - three in water to the right and one on land to the left. The color palette includes muted earth tones such as brown, grey, blue, and green, with hints of orange and red. The single bird stands on the shore with greenery behind it, while the three birds swim in the water. Two branches with round fruits frame the scene at the top.

artworks.title: Plate 31: Duck, Merganser, and Three Goldfinches
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various species of birds in a natural landscape. Two ducks are shown by a body of water in a grassy area. Above them, three smaller birds are perched on a branch with a pear. The image is framed in an oval shape, set against a plain background. Botanical illustrations of plants are on the left side of the frame. Latin text is inscribed at the top, and a Roman numeral "XXXI" is marked in the lower right corner. The style is reminiscent of Audubon.

artworks.title: Plate 32: A Green-Winged Teal, a Juvenile Green Woodpecker, and Two Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features four birds within an oval frame. Two ducks are on the ground near water, while two smaller birds are perched on branches above them. The color palette includes earthy tones, greens, reds, blues, and hints of gold. The ducks are positioned apart, with one on the left and the other on the right. Above them, a branch extends supporting the smaller birds, one with a long red tongue to the left and another with orange-toned feathers to the right. The background within the oval is clear.

artworks.title: Plate 33: A Pair of Bohemian Waxwings, a Shelduck(?), and a Brant Goose with a Ginger Plant
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: There are two ducks on the ground, one with dark plumage and the other with a mix of green, brown, and grey colors on its feathers. Above them on a curved tree branch, there are two smaller birds, one resting and the other standing. The color palette is a blend of natural tones – earthy browns and greens dominate, accompanied by hints of black, grey, and subtle blues and purple on the ducks' feet. The ducks are centrally located, with the dark duck on the left and the multicolored duck on the right. The tree branch stretches above them from left to right, with the two smaller birds situated near the center and right of the branch.

artworks.title: Plate 34: Bird of Paradise with Mereganser(?) and Grebe(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds within a circular frame. The first bird has a long, flowing tail of iridescent hues. The second bird has dark plumage with a lighter underbelly and is swimming. The third bird is small with warm tones, resting on the water. Each bird is labeled with a number. Script in a decorative font encircles the top of the illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 35: Female Green-Winged Teal, Red-Breasted Merganser(?), Sparrow, and a Greenfinch(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nature scene featuring birds and ducks near a body of water. The scene is set within an oval frame, depicting two ducks in the lower portion - one is on land, while the other is on the water. Above them, perched on a branch of a fruit-bearing tree with lush green leaves, are two smaller birds. The branch is positioned diagonally across the frame. Additionally, sentences of text are inscribed both above and below the image while Roman numerals mark it as part of a series.

artworks.title: Plate 36: Red-Breasted Merganser, Shoveler, and Mallard, and Duck with Artichokes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of four birds standing in and around water, with a decorative element above. The image shows a group of four birds positioned on the edge of a water body. One bird is completely in the water, while the others are either in shallow water or on the shore. Above the scene, there is an ornamental feature consisting of paisley-like patterned leaves and ribbons. The image is framed within an oval border, with the number "XXVI" written on the right edge within the frame. This is in the style of an ornithological illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 37: Three Waterfowl with Two Nightingales(?)  Perched in Citrus Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is an image of birds and fruit. It shows three ducks or similar waterfowl on a grassy and watery ground in the lower part of the composition, and two smaller birds perched on branches of a lemon tree in the upper section. Lemons, some ripe and others still growing, hang above the birds. The painting is reminiscent of works by early botanists or ornithologists who documented wildlife. It is marked with Latin inscriptions and a Roman numeral on the right.

artworks.title: Plate 38: Merganser with Two Other Waterfowl and a Garland of Melons and Gourds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds in a natural setting with decorative elements. Above the scene of a lake, there are three birds, one flying over the water and two swimming. The sky is clear with no clouds, the vegetation is sparse, and the water is mostly calm. The scene is framed within an oval, with a decorative element above consisting of squash, foliage, and ribbon. On the right side of the image, the Roman numeral XXXVIII is inscribed.

artworks.title: Plate 3: Two Hawks
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two large brown birds are depicted next to each other on a grassy ground within an oval frame. The birds are shaded in different hues of brown with yellow accents on their talons. They stand near a large green fern leaf and several smaller plants. The background is colored in shades of pale cream and green. The birds are facing to the right in profile, with one slightly ahead of the other, both positioned near the center of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 39: A Scaup with Two Other Waterfowl beneath a Garland of Produce
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays three birds, each numbered from one to three, situated in a natural setting with water and grass. The birds have different hues; the first has dark brown and white feathers, the second has blue, brown, and white feathers, and the third shares a color palette similar to the first with earthy tones. Above the birds, there is an intricately drawn arrangement of a melon with ribbon-like elements. The top area above the oval frame features a Latin inscription. The birds are positioned in the lower half of the oval frame, with two on the left in water and grass, while one stands on the right near the water's edge.

artworks.title: Plate 40: European Bee-Eater and Exotic Chicken
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: There is a bird perched on a branch on the left and a standing bird on a small grassy mound on the right. The left bird is slender with multi-colored plumage primarily in shades of green, blue, and hints of red. The right bird has a robust body with dark feathers transitioning from gray to a rusty red on its chest and head, topped with a crest. The scene features a soft, muted color palette with earth tones, namely greens, browns, and grays. The branch extends from the left side towards the center, with the small bird perched upon it, while the larger bird stands to the right side of the image. Both birds are contained within an oval frame, positioned against a pale background.

artworks.title: Plate 41: Two Gray Geese with Songbirds in a Cherry Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows several birds, including a pair of geese standing on grass. The color palette consists of earthy tones, greens, greys, browns, red cherries, and yellow-green tones. The birds are placed around a circular border, with the geese at the bottom, and smaller birds perched on branches above. The geese are numbered 1 and 2, and there are other birds numbered 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 on branches. The scene is framed in a circular manner against a plain background, with text at the top.

artworks.title: Plate 42: Two Gray Geese with a Third Bird and Hanging Grapes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Three birds, labeled 1, 2, and 3, are perched on rocky terrain in the center of the image. Above them, a vine with green and purple grapes and hanging fruits is illustrated. The color palette includes earthy tones for the birds and rocks, vibrant green and purple for the grapes, and red and brown hues for the hanging fruits. The birds are positioned in a row, each on different rocks, with the largest bird (#2) facing to the right, while the bird on the left (#1) faces right and the bird on the right (#3) faces leftward.

artworks.title: Plate 43: Sandpipers and Other Shore Birds Admiring a Garland of Flowers
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Four birds are standing on a grassy patch with one near a small body of water. The largest bird is gray with a long beak on the left, while the other three birds are varying shades of brown and gray on the right. The color palette contains natural hues such as browns, grays, greens, and blue from the water and sky reflection. Above the birds is an arrangement of colorful plants and fruits within a circular frame. Latin text appears at the top and bottom of the image, along with additional numbers and words. The scene is set against a plain cream background.

artworks.title: Plate 44: Godwit(?) and Sandpipers with Two Gourds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting depicts several birds on a small patch of land with two hanging fruits in an enclosed setting. The central bird is blue, standing on one leg on a small mound of grass surrounded by water. On either side of this bird, there are two more birds, one with a darker body and another with white and brown plumage, both with long beaks. The scene is enclosed in a circle with two large fruits hanging from a curved branch that stretches across the top. The background is a bare, beige parchment, and the number "XXXIV" is inscribed to the right. The style resembles early natural history illustrations, emphasizing detailed and realistic portrayals of wildlife.

artworks.title: Plate 45: Spotted Nutcracker and Shore Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds around a pond. The birds are perched on rocks and a tree branch, with two birds standing on the ground near the water. The detailed birds have distinct patterns on their feathers and are numbered. The pond reflects the natural hues of the environment within a circular frame against a plain background. Above the birds are numbers, and below the image, there is a line of text in Latin that reads, "Claudite Jam Rivos pueri, sat prata biberunt." This composition is delicate and stylized, reminiscent of illustrations from natural history manuscripts. This is in the style of traditional scientific illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 46: Bats, Quail, and Oystercatcher(?) by the Water
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various animals, including birds and bats, in a natural setting. The painting showcases a collection of fauna within an oval frame. In the foreground, there is a black and white bird with a red bill standing on grass-covered land, alongside two smaller brown birds. Two bats with wings spread open hover above them. To the right, a bird is perched on rocky terrain under a tree branch with leaves and purple flowers. In the background, there is a calm expanse of water meeting the horizon. The image is rendered with precision and detail reminiscent of naturalist illustrations by artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Plate 47: Shore Birds with a Perching Bird
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows five birds of different species within a circular border. Two brown birds are on the right, one predominantly grey bird is on a branch, and two grey birds with black markings are near water and grass. The color palette includes brown, grey, green, and pale red accents on berries. The birds are arranged with one on a branch at the center right, two standing on the left, and two on the ground to the right.

artworks.title: Plate 48: Wood Grouse, Rail, and Curlew with Hazelnuts and Figs
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows four birds and two branches with leaves and fruit encased in a large oval. The birds are arranged in different positions, with one on a branch in the top right and three on the ground, and one on a branch to the top left. The colors in the image are earth-toned, with browns, creams, and greens dominating, and touches of purple on the fruit. The three birds in the center are on the ground, with two standing close together facing each other and the third nearby, while the fourth bird is perched on a branch to the right. In the top left, a branch with green and purple fruit reaches towards the center. In the bottom, there is a small blue patch suggestive of water against the yellow-brown ground.

artworks.title: Plate 4: An Egyptian Vulture, a Northern Goshawk(?), and an "Aquila Heteropode" (Short Toed Eagle?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three birds surrounding a plant. The drawing depicts three birds positioned around a flowering plant with extended, green leaves and a singular yellow flower at its top. The first bird is perched on a rock with grey plumage. The second bird is in the center foreground with its beak open. The third bird stands atop a stump with a slightly curved beak and intricate feather detailing. The landscape within the oval frame shows a serene natural setting with rocks. Latin text is on the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 49: Gulls with a Carob Tree and a Pistachio Tree(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several seabirds surrounded by branches and foliage. Various birds are depicted within an oval frame, each numbered from one to four, perched on branches with leaves and fruit. The birds are overlooking a body of water, suggesting a coastal environment. The detailed rendering highlights their varied plumage colors and textures. The birds are presented in a naturalistic setting, including water, grass, and trees. Latin text is present at the top, bottom, and right of the composition.

artworks.title: Plate 50: An Avocet with Two Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image contains three birds: one perched on a tree branch, another on the ground near a small pool of water, and the third bird dipping its beak into the water. The colors in the image are natural, with earthy browns, grays, blues, greens, and red from berries on the ground. The tallest bird is in the center, slightly leaning to the left, with a smaller bird to its right and a perched bird above them on a branch. The background consists of tree branches and leaves forming a circular frame around the birds.
